reason: The sole cited evidence (E1) discusses mechanical properties and corrosion resistance of CoCrFeMnNi and Co-Cr-Mo alloys, with no mention of spinel oxides, catalytic supports, oxygen vacancies, or CO oxidation. None of the key premises are supported by this evidence.
premises: High configurational entropy in a spinel oxide support stabilizes isolated Pt-group metal sites against sintering.
High-entropy oxide supports enhance oxygen vacancy density and electronic conductivity.
Enhanced oxygen vacancy density and conductivity lower the activation barrier for CO oxidation.
A 7-metal high-entropy spinel oxide can be synthesized and used as a catalyst support.
The proposed mechanism leads to a ~60% reduction in light-off temperature versus a 4-metal spinel.
